metadata.name: global_asinh_v1_backward_anchored_gripper_metric
metadata.description: q01 and q99 encode offset=(q01+q99)/2 and scale=(q99-q01)/2 for the canonical 59D action.

provenance.ego_translation_override: Set zero offset and the same 0.2822-meter scale for x, y, and z.
provenance.ego_translation_rationale: AV motion is primarily along z while general camera motion is directionally unconstrained, so there is no robust cross-domain rule for axis-specific centers or scales.
provenance.metric_gripper_override: Set both gripper slots to YAM's zero-closed, 0.082-meter fully-open reference range.

layout.0:3: ego translation xyz in meters; zero-centered with scale 0.2822 meters per axis
layout.3:9: ego rotation as rot6d from HandPose
layout.9:12: right wrist translation xyz in meters from YAM
layout.12:18: right wrist rotation as rot6d from YAM
layout.18:33: right fingertips: thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky xyz in the wrist frame from HandPose
layout.33:34: right gripper width in meters, where 0 is closed and 0.082 is the YAM fully-open reference width
layout.34:37: left wrist translation xyz in meters from YAM
layout.37:43: left wrist rotation as rot6d from YAM
layout.43:58: left fingertips: thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky xyz in the wrist frame from HandPose
layout.58:59: left gripper width in meters, where 0 is closed and 0.082 is the YAM fully-open reference width
